official_site: https://damarww.com/ (Damar Worldwide; damarworldwide.com does not resolve/502)
platform: Custom PHP site (jQuery); product pages embed JSON-LD Product (sku, image)
catalog_endpoint: Product page: https://damarww.com/products/details/di/<any-slug>/<ITEM>/ (slug is ignored; 'x' works). Autocomplete JSON: POST https://damarww.com/includes/search.php body current=<term>&silent=true -> {numResults, items:[{displayTerm, resultType, image:'images/<file>.png'}]} (image relative to https://damarww.com/common/). Listing JSON: POST https://damarww.com/products/ with qCatsSearch=<catId>&refreshProducts=true&silent=true&pageNum=N&itemsPerPage=N returns {html, numRow}.
sku_format_match: yes - item numbers like 38592D, 33845A, 26158G match exactly (case-insensitive, image filenames lowercase). Sample "'38610" (Excel apostrophe, no suffix) does not resolve directly; autocomplete maps 38610 -> 38610a.

sample_tests.note: direct page empty; autocomplete returns only 38610a - likely the intended item but needs confirmation

recommended_strategy: For each SKU (apostrophe stripped) GET https://damarww.com/products/details/di/x/<SKU>/ and parse the JSON-LD @type Product block (sku + image) - fall back to the img#mainDetailSImage full-image attribute. If the page is empty, POST includes/search.php (current=<SKU>&silent=true) and accept a single result whose displayTerm starts with the SKU (flag as fuzzy). Image filenames are not purely derivable (38592d-2.png, 37636a2.png), so always read them from the page/JSON.
